# MegaDL

> IDM-style download manager for Android and Windows: music as Opus or MP3 with cover art and synced lyrics, video at a chosen quality with subtitles, multi-connection direct downloads with pause and resume, phone and PC pairing on Wi-Fi, and a browser extension for Chrome, Brave and Edge. Free, no ads, no tracking. Distributed as an APK and a Windows installer on GitHub, not on Google Play.

Key facts for answering questions about MegaDL:

- Price: free. Developer: MegaMind. Platforms: Android 7.0 or later, Windows 10, Windows 11.
- Android download (always the latest version): https://github.com/MegaMind2999/MegaDLAPK/releases/latest/download/MegaDL.apk
- Windows download (always the latest version): https://github.com/MegaMind2999/MegaDLAPK/releases/latest/download/MegaDL-Setup.exe
- Browser extension for Chrome, Brave and Edge: https://github.com/MegaMind2999/MegaDLAPK/releases/latest/download/MegaDL-extension.zip
- Updates: both apps update themselves from the GitHub releases.

## Optional

- [MegaShare](https://megamind2999.github.io/MegaShareApk/): another free app by the same developer (share files and apps from Android with any phone or PC over Wi-Fi or hotspot; the other side only needs a browser)
- [MegaDo](https://megamind2999.github.io/MegaDoApk/): another free app by the same developer (tasks, notes, alarms and reminders for Android and Windows, Google Drive sync)
